title: Hours each hospital turned ambulances away
question: Which San Francisco hospitals declare ambulance diversion most, and how often is diversion suspended city-wide?
finding: Zuckerberg San Francisco General, the City's own hospital, declared the most diversion hours: 3,852 in 2024 (42% of all hospitals), 2,868 in 2025 (36% of all hospitals), 2,033 in 2026 (40% of all hospitals). Diversion was suspended city-wide 721 times in 2024 and 371 in 2025.
how: Sum of duration_in_minutes by hospital and the year the diversion started (t4sf-777q; 2026 runs to the end of September); suspensions counted from 6x9s-ipug.
limits: Diversion is an operational measure of a full emergency department, not a finding about money or conduct; a busy trauma centre diverts more. Nothing here bears on billing. The file starts at the end of December 2023.

sources.t: San Francisco Department of Emergency Management (Emergency Medical Services Agency): Hospital Diversions (DataSF t4sf-777q, saved 23 November 2026)
San Francisco Department of Emergency Management (Emergency Medical Services Agency): Hospital Suspensions (DataSF 6x9s-ipug, saved 23 November 2026)
